section_title: Interlinkages between desertification, land degradation, food security and greenhouse gas fluxes
summary: This assessment summarizes the mitigation, adaptation, and desertification-control potentials of various land management and value chain response options, based on IPCC Chapter 6.

Integrated response options based on land management of soils
passages.text: When grasslands are converted to croplands, they lose about 36% of their soil organic carbon stocks after 20 years (Poeplau et al. 2011). Assuming an average starting soil organic carbon stock of grasslands of 115 tC ha–1 (Poeplau et al. 2011), this is equivalent to a loss of 41.5 tC ha–1 on conversion to cropland.
